how: Recruitment calls seek placers to revive and spread a consuming colour faction.
Members judge targets against the defenders they can overcome rather than only the size of their desired mark.
A member supplies a particular target proposal that another member answers without establishing one founder for the whole room.
A target proposal locally gathers an answer committing to action and requesting coordinates.
Recruitment calls and damage reports occur without a cited passage identifying which call produced the reported placing.
A request for coordinates receives an exact location as the next reply.
A participant answers a target redirect with bare assent and a status report.
A redirect receives local assent without establishing the frequency of bare acceptance across the room.
Joining a proposed action can open an instruction exchange rather than end in an answer asking for nothing back.
Proposed teams, allocated portions and polls make this an evidenced local exception without disputing the aggregate claim about most rooms.

statement: Contesting access and authority across coordination venues
how: Restricted access and anti-spy closures make participation depend on negotiating venue entry as well as finding a shared plan.

statement: Contesting commands while using locally effective coordination
how: Reports of ignored votes, sanctions and divided directions coexist with an effective push rather than showing either settled command or entirely spontaneous action.
Members circulate customizable scripts and report repurposing hostile bots to place black.
Scripts and hostile automation are evidenced but the cited concepts do not establish maintenance exhaustion as the cause of adoption.
Manual tactics target correctly coloured defender pixels while leaving other colours for defenders to spend their own placements repairing.
Participants propose permanent territory, signatures and static while disputing the appearance and purpose of their mark.
Coordinates and competing appearance proposals do not establish design deliberation being settled by a shared template.
Members report active damage and canvas conditions during the contest rather than only remembering them afterward.
Some participants explicitly stop growth to defend and purify a fixed core.
Upkeep describes the fixed-core option rather than the whole room because other participants reject cleaning and prioritize consuming movement.
Keeping the work follows building only for participants who value retaining the core rather than completing consumption and permitting rebuilding.

statement: Consuming and moving on without waiting for loss
how: Mobility can be an intended way to consume or a sign of mission completion rather than a response to erasure or insufficient defensive capacity.
Participants justify maintaining visible pure cores as calling signs for unaffiliated sympathizers without demonstrating the claimed recruitment effect.
Participants attribute loss and division to scattered attacks and leaders while the account retains these as their causal allegations.
Ceasefire and treaty announcements coexist with doctrinal opposition to alliances rather than establishing one accepted policy.
Restraint calls appeal both to the value of protected work and to the cost of fighting strong defenders.
Outsiders offer conditional help and requesters can be required to contribute labour before their requests receive support.
An alliance announcement evidences coalition talk without independently confirming coordinated defence or a durable joint organization.
An explicitly identified envoy brings another room's protest about destroyed work into this room.
A report that a location is lost explicitly accompanies an order to retreat.
Loss-linked retreat is visible but the coded passage does not establish a prior judgment of too few hands as its mechanism.
Requests about artwork and cores do not establish a guest work governed by a host room's rules.
The agreement appeal survives but its pruned replies do not preserve enough coded evidence to verify the claimed dispute over binding authority.
An invocation of a prior agreement does not itself establish that the agreement prompted a dispute about who could bind the room.
Treaty announcements do not establish upkeep pressure as the cause of border negotiation.
An appeal not to attack invokes a prior agreement without demonstrating that placers subsequently observed restraint.
A proposal to use others for defence and an outsider's conditional offer do not establish defensive shortage causing help to arrive.
A conditional help offer does not demonstrate that an earlier border negotiation opened the exchange.
Alliance talk does not demonstrate that pressure maintaining a core caused this room to join coordinated mutual defence.
Members profess a colour faith and convert affiliations during the event without requiring evidence of a pre-canvas identity.
The colour faith can authorize incompatible practices because renewal, indiscriminate consumption and purity remain disputed participant doctrines.
The empty baseline cannot establish whether any particular target call carries a quarrel from before the canvas.
Current colour identity and equal-consumption claims do not date an antecedent tie or rule out individual inherited rivalries.
A situation-room master thread evidences an attempt to concentrate venue coordination without establishing enforced removals or ordinary-business displacement.
Recruitment calls and structural announcements do not establish that a flood of calls caused the host to contain canvas talk.
An individual calls the event an April Fools joke without establishing a host-level parody or takeover frame.
Members honour every black pixel and participant rather than celebrating only a surviving finished picture.
Defeat claims prompt a retrospective defence of temporary black masses and dynamic timelapse work as success.
A cleaned final version prompts competing claims that chaos is art and that utter darkness was the goal.
Participants carry core creation, recruitment, consumption and defence onto successor canvases after original placement ends.
Continuing on another canvas does not make it equivalent when participants consider the original time limit essential to the event.
The end of original placement can directly prompt migration into renewed placing while later successor defence remains unresolved.
Pride in contributions does not establish that a preceding finished-state report caused the celebration.
Celebration and timelapse accounts coexist without a coded passage establishing celebration as the cause of recording.
Migration explicitly answers closure while the coded record does not establish recording as its cause.
Attack calls can construct the room's own core by consuming a target rather than oppose building as a separate stage.
Target selection exploits existing black pixels and weak or inactive defence without requiring an antecedent rivalry.
Mobilization can already be a call to consume a target and establish a core rather than first mobilizing a separate constructive project.
An expansion call receives a refusal explicitly justified by the effort invested in the threatened work.
An appeal invokes an earlier agreement as grounds to stop attacking without establishing subsequent compliance.
Participants carry contest through invitations to fight back and post-event salutes.
Verbal contest is present but separate taunts and salutes do not establish the proposed causal chain from a particular attack.

statement: Justifying consumption through renewal and enjoyment
how: Challenges to destruction elicit claims about future artists and teamwork that explain participant commitments without proving renewal effects or collective consensus.
